page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with Latin prose and Syriac lines set as verse. No marginal notes. A catchword stands at the lower right. Page number at top right.

main_text.p: modum per te nobis evenerunt omnia bona de-calo, ita & preces nostras, atque humiles supplicationes cum suffitu hoc thymiamatum, illi, qui invariabiliter, & qua Deum decet, ex te natus est, offeras pro salute, & liberatione animarum nostrarum, & corporum. Ibidem statione 2. ad sanctos Prophetas, Apostolos, & Martyres.

Oeconomi estis Prophetae, Apostoli, & Martyres, Aperite thesaurum precum vestrarum, & auxilia prabete egentibus. Item in hymno S. Iacobi, qui legitur in commemoratione Beatae Virginis Mariae ad Missam:
Perfice in nobis amorem tuum precibus matris tuae, que te supplicat, ut offeramus tibi thura pura in die illius commemorationis. Concede no-

page.notes: The Syriac lines (three before the hymn heading, five in the hymn) are not transcribed: the scan is too small to read the letters reliably, so each line is marked illegible with an estimated letter count. The word "que" in the last paragraph and "prabete" are copied as they appear on the scan and may need checking. Small stray marks lie in the right margin near the lower text and at the bottom left; they are not printed text and are left out.
